companies.name: The Springbok Group of Companies
companies.distributes: Chocolate, chips and biscuits (Bakers Biscuits shown in its portfolio) from local and imported North American and European suppliers, plus dairy, health and beauty and pet food.
companies.channels_supplied: Large retail chains, independent traders, spaza shops, cafes, convenience stores, forecourts and pharmacies across South Africa and SADC export markets.
companies.fit_rationale: A Johannesburg-headquartered independent FMCG distributor that buys from local and international suppliers and sells to chains, independents and spaza shops, with chocolate, chips and biscuits as a named portfolio line. Scale: deliveries to more than 12,500 unique locations nationwide and across SADC, with an export division into eight African markets. Storage: warehousing in South Africa and its own fleet of trailers and straight trucks.
what_they_do_well: Delivers to more than 12,500 unique outlets nationwide, from large retailers to spaza shops and cafes.
